children: Leonardo DRS will develop a next-generation infrared focal plane array for the THAAD interceptor missile under a new contract from BAE Systems.
Terms of the deal weren't disclosed.
Defense-technology company DRS said Thursday the agreement builds on its history of infrared-sensor innovation and its collaboration with BAE Systems across a broad range of advanced capabilities.

Development work on the project and capacity expansion efforts are underway at DRS's foundry in Dallas, it said. The Arlington, Va., company said its objective is to increase seeker production to about four times historical levels.
